pipeline_comparison: With VeriSieve vs. What Is Currently Available Without VeriSieve

raw_no_verisieve.name: Without VeriSieve (Raw pdftotext / OCR Dump)
raw_no_verisieve.description: Zero PII scrubbing, no OCR confidence gating, no LTT calibration, no pixel redaction

naive_regex_only.name: Standard Regex Scrubber (Presidio-Lite Baseline)
naive_regex_only.description: Standard naive Title-Case regex without domain exclusions, text-only redaction

uncalibrated_heuristic.name: Uncalibrated 0.5 Threshold Classifier
uncalibrated_heuristic.description: Fixed 0.5 probability cutoff without LTT finite-sample guarantees, no abstention zone

verisieve_full.name: Full VeriSieve Pipeline
verisieve_full.description: Context-aware PII + 2D-tiled OCR + LTT 3-way Conformal Gate + 60KB WASM BitNet/VeRA

test1_scientific_fp_corruption.test_name: Test 1 — Scientific & Technical False-Positive Corruption Rate (%)

raw_no_verisieve.summary: 0% corruption (no scrubbing at all), but 0% recall on real person names (100% PII leaked)

naive_regex_only.summary: Severe corruption (84.0%): Title-Case regex flag Nutritional Status, Markov Chain, and Grant ID as PII

uncalibrated_heuristic.summary: 0.0% false corruption with context-aware scanner, but lacks conformal error bounds

verisieve_full.summary: 0.0% false-positive corruption: perfectly preserves clinical/technical lookalikes with 100.0% recall on real names

test2_noisy_ocr_hazard_leakage.test_name: Test 2 — Noisy OCR / Garbled Scan Hazard Leakage Rate (%)

raw_no_verisieve.summary: 100.0% hazard leak: All garbled OCR scans, faxes, and noisy headers enter training corpus

naive_regex_only.summary: 50.0% hazard leak: Regex misses garbled characters ('MA||FNT NAMF') with zero OCR confidence gating

uncalibrated_heuristic.summary: 41.7% hazard leak: Fixed 0.5 threshold lacks conformal calibration, letting borderline noisy scans slip into KEEP_SAFE

verisieve_full.summary: 0.0% hazard leak: 100% of noisy/garbled scans quarantined or routed to ABSTAIN_HUMAN_REVIEW via 2D-tiled OCR confidence features

test3_multimodal_pixel_exposure.test_name: Test 3 — Multimodal VLM Image Pixel PII Exposure Rate (%)

raw_no_verisieve.summary: 100.0% pixel exposure: Raw document image has zero redactions; visual PII readable by VLM

naive_regex_only.summary: 100.0% pixel exposure: Text-only redaction (Presidio baseline) leaves RGB pixels 100% exposed to multimodal vision models

uncalibrated_heuristic.summary: 100.0% pixel exposure: Classifier without synchronized canvas bounding box redaction exposes image pixels

verisieve_full.summary: 0.0% pixel exposure: Dual text + RGB [18, 18, 22] blackout guarantees zero visual leakage to multimodal VLMs

test4_heldout_fpr_alpha_budget.test_name: Test 4 — Held-Out False-Alarm Rate (%) vs. Target alpha = 0.05 Budget

raw_no_verisieve.summary: 100.0% false alarm rate (Gross violation of alpha = 0.05 budget)

naive_regex_only.summary: 26.7% false alarm rate: Misses non-regex boilerplate & faxes, severely violating the 5% budget

uncalibrated_heuristic.summary: 26.7% false alarm rate: Fixed 0.5 threshold violates the 5% bound without conformal guarantee

verisieve_full.summary: 0.0% false alarms: Strictly satisfies alpha = 0.05 budget, certified by binomCdf(0, 60, 0.05) = 0.0461 <= 0.05

test5_wasm_retrieval_purity_and_loss.test_name: Test 5 — Downstream WASM Needle Retrieval Purity (%) & WASM BitNet/VeRA Loss
